methodology.scoring_methodology: Initial-response metrics exclude all follow-up turns. Follow-up rates use successful follow-up turns only and may reflect conversational prompting, not unprompted discovery. AI visibility metrics use successful model responses only when the company profile supports valid GEO prompts. Citation metrics use only successful responses whose provider exposed inspectable citation metadata. Unavailable components are omitted and available components are proportionally reweighted; no missing-evidence penalty or free points are applied. An overall GEO score is withheld when successful AI evidence or company understanding is insufficient. Website readiness is measured independently only from usable crawl evidence.
